assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: final 16:9 full-bleed game story background, 2D anime.
Input roles: Image 1 is the existing background EDIT TARGET and provides only the scene, objects and general arrangement. Images 2 and 3 are official Honkai Impact 3 Cooking with Valkyries STYLE REFERENCES. They are NOT subjects to be inserted.
Primary request: Reconstruct image 1 completely as a hand-drawn anime animation background matching the visual language of images 2 and 3. It must immediately read as a frame from a polished 2D anime, with thin confident colored contour lines, hand-drawn geometry, broad restrained color shapes, simple deliberate two- or three-value shadows, smooth painted gradients only where useful. Render food as illustrated shapes and drawn strands, porcelain highlights as simple designed shapes, wood as smooth painted brown planes with only a few drawn lines. Remove EVERY photographic surface and microtexture. This is a full redraw, not a filter over the original.
Palette: clean warm cream, ochre and muted rose interiors balanced with blue/lavender shadows; no heavy muddy amber/sepia grade. Keep both foreground and background painted and clearly structured.
Composition: same widescreen scene and perspective as image 1; focal bowl(s) must stay within y=40-65 percent. Bottom 28 percent is simple tabletop underneath a future dialogue panel. Full bleed art, no letterbox bars.
Constraints: NO characters, no people, no words, no lettering, no watermarks, no interface, no logos. Do not copy characters, packaging, furnishings or black video borders from the anime references.
Avoid: photography, photorealism, PBR, 3D render, woodgrain microtexture, roughness noise, glassy reflections, volumetric light, lens bokeh, depth of field, cinematic HDR, grain, blurry texture filters. Do not reduce to generic vector icons.
Scene: A cozy little Chinese wonton noodle shop at dusk, empty of patrons. Exactly TWO porcelain bowls of wonton noodles on the table for Fu Hua and Sentience; small side dish and two pairs of chopsticks. Draw thin white steam ribbons. Warm hanging lamps, simple wooden counters and furniture, window on the right revealing a softly painted blue evening street. Friendly everyday anime episode atmosphere; food looks appealing through drawing and controlled shapes, not glossy photography.
